List the vulnerability scans of every repository (administrators)

List the vulnerability scans across all repositories, newest first
(GET /api/security/scans).

On Repsy OS this route is for administrators only; anyone else gets a
permission error (HTTP 403, exit 1) and nothing is listed. To read the scans of
one package version use 'rp scan show'.

--severity keeps scans whose highest severity is that one, --type one format
(maven, npm, pypi, docker, cargo, nuget, go, helm, ruby) and --repo the
repositories whose name contains the text (case-insensitive). --sort is
createdAt,asc or createdAt,desc (Repsy OS).

```
rp scan list [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --limit int         Stop after this many scans (0 means all)
      --repo string       Only repositories whose name contains this text
      --severity string   Only scans whose highest severity is this one
      --sort string       Sort by createdAt,asc|desc
      --type string       Only repositories of this format
```
